content.short: Heurist brings AI-driven financial intelligence to on-chain markets through agentic finance tools.
content.description: Heurist builds agentic finance tools that bring institutional-style financial intelligence to retail investors through AI. Stable's official documentation lists it among the x402 payment facilitators for the network, the component that verifies and settles agent payments. Agent payments settled in stablecoins are one of the use cases Stable is explicitly built around.
content.meta: Heurist brings AI-driven financial intelligence to on-chain markets and facilitates x402 payments on Stable.
